commercial_source_rule: Every paid SKU is original by default.

sku001_freeze.rule: Do not add third-party code or runtime dependencies.

internal_qa.cmdr_concepts: Use deterministic command-style test hooks internally; do not ship Cmdr by default.
internal_qa.testing_concepts: Assert behavior and successful state transitions, not marker/object presence.
internal_qa.coverage_concepts: Maintain a critical-path matrix and require at least one regression for every security-sensitive path.

required_runtime_checks: reset or rejoin behavior when relevant
sku002_house_controls_required_paths: authorized garage control changes state exactly once
valid recolor applies and malformed payload is rejected
remote abuse produces no privileged state change
rapid duplicate requests do not duplicate side effects
one player cannot mutate another player's house
shipment_rule: Internal dev harnesses and third-party QA dependencies must be excluded from release artifacts unless explicitly approved after license review.
